rule.name: MutableStaticCollection
rule.message: Do not mutate a static collection or expose a mutable one. Build it once as an immutable List.of, Map.of or Map.copyOf, or keep the state in an instance.
rule.description: A static final collection that is public or changed after class loading is global mutable state.
